summary: Grupo Simec, S.A.B. de C.V. produces, processes, and distributes special steels and structural steel profiles in Mexico, the United States, Canada, and Brazil. It offers steel wire and derivatives, special bar quality steel, rebar, and commercial and structural long products. The company was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in Guadalajara, Mexico. Grupo Simec, S.A.B. de C.V. is a subsidiary of Industrias CH, S.A.B. de C.V.
